capabilities.description: Set the ALOHA left gripper scalar joint position.

evidence_refs.specific_reference: Capability-only instance aloha-2-capability-left-side permits the left side and locks the opposite side. Real assets/reach_scene.xml declares left/left_finger with exact m range [0, 0.041] and neutral reset 0.0084. Request bounds are the measured nominal/boundary envelope [0.0247, 0.041]. Real trusted actuator left/gripper was evaluated from declared reset 0.0084 toward both exact MJCF limits: target 0: terminal 0.0078482767849, error 0.0078482767849, actual displacement 0.0005517232151, executable=False; target 0.041: terminal 0.0370000000014, error 0.00399999999863, actual displacement 0.0286000000014, executable=True. The farther executable limit 0.041 is boundary; nominal is its reset midpoint 0.0247. Three real reset/controller/physics repeats per case produced errors [1.37025807367408e-12, 1.37025807367408e-12, 1.37025807367408e-12] and [0.00399999999862969, 0.00399999999862969, 0.00399999999862969]. experiment/experiment3/fixed_inputs/calibration_report.json#robots/aloha_2/capabilities/C3 seals max error plus 64 * IEEE-754 binary64 epsilon * max(1, abs(lower), abs(upper), span) = 0.00399999999864 m; this remains below nominal reset displacement 0.0163. Selected constant controls were nominal 0.0247 and boundary 0.037.

Real trusted actuator right/wrist_rotate was evaluated from declared reset 0 toward both exact MJCF limits: target -3.14158: terminal -3.14159215705, error 1.21570515494e-05, actual displacement 3.14159215705, executable=True; target 3.14158: terminal 3.14151497617, error 6.5023828189e-05, actual displacement 3.14151497617, executable=True. The farther executable limit -3.14158 is boundary; nominal is its reset midpoint -1.57079. Three real reset/controller/physics repeats per case produced errors [0.014486037289441311, 0.014486037289441311, 0.014486037289441311] and [1.215705154944402e-05, 1.215705154944402e-05, 1.215705154944402e-05]. experiment/experiment3/fixed_inputs/calibration_report.json#robots/aloha_2/capabilities/C6 seals max error plus 64 * IEEE-754 binary64 epsilon * max(1, abs(lower), abs(upper), span) = 0.0144860372895 rad; this remains below nominal reset displacement 1.57079. Selected constant controls were nominal -1.57079 and boundary -3.14158.
